# HealthTrack — Multi-Platform Health Monitoring

## Goals
- Build a health monitoring platform across web, iOS, and Android
- HIPAA compliance for all patient data
- Real-time vitals dashboard for healthcare providers
- Integration with wearable devices
- Machine learning models for anomaly detection

## User Stories
- As a patient, I can track my vitals on my mobile phone
- As a doctor, I can view patient dashboards on the web
- As a nurse, I can receive real-time alerts on the mobile app
- As an admin, I can manage HIPAA compliance settings
- As a data scientist, I can train models on anonymized data

## Stakeholders
- Healthcare providers
- Patients
- Compliance team
- Data science team
- Mobile engineering team

## Tech Stack
- React web frontend
- iOS native (Swift)
- Android native (Kotlin)
- Python backend with FastAPI
- Postgres and MongoDB databases
- Kubernetes for orchestration
- Terraform for infrastructure
- AWS cloud infrastructure
- Kafka for event streaming
- HIPAA and SOC2 compliance required
- GraphQL API layer

## Timeline
9 months

## Compliance
- HIPAA certification required
- SOC 2 Type II audit planned
- GDPR compliance for EU users
